_comment: The shared publishing profile of smart-base and the layers built on it (smart-*, dth-*): the WHO migration plan, step T3 (owner decision Q-WP-1 = A, 2026-11-15; litlfred/smart-base#421). stagingRoot is each checkout's own GitHub Pages, {owner} being the checkout's GitHub owner (derived, never declared). iriRoot is FIXED to the WHO staging root, so a fork and WHO mint the same IRIs (Q-MIG-3 = B, 2026-11-11). publishedRoot is where a layer's IRIs and site move when it is published. A layer declares only `publish: {id, stage, profile: "smart-base/schemas/publishing.json"}` on its index.config.json entry, and cat-harness-tools' `iri-base:sync` derives its iriBase from this file. Read by smart-base/schemas/site-roots.ts.
